static_traits.name: Li Ming
static_traits.family_status: a few family and friends can offer support, but the client is unwilling to discuss financial anxiety with them
static_traits.social_status: financial stress causing some Interpersonal tension
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; experienced financial difficulties and bankruptcy in the past; never received treatment for similar psychological problems before
static_traits.language_features: clear expression, highly cooperative, fairly strong logic; anxious mood but Neutral attitude; able to recall and describe automatic thoughts

basic_info.main_problem: excessive worry and anxiety about losing all money due to past bankruptcy experiences, this looming financial 'sense of disaster' persisting since the last bankruptcy and intensifying during economic downturns or market volatility.
basic_info.core_demands: Fear and anxiety have affected decision-making ability and overall well-being, seeking support and guidance in counseling to ease anxiety and improve decisions.
growth_experiences: experienced multiple bankruptcies and severe financial difficulties, since then highly sensitive to economic downturns, market volatility and negative financial news; though trying financial management techniques and consulting financial advisors, anxiety repeatedly returns and gradually intensifies.

core_beliefs: my financial decisions are unreliable and will eventually bankrupt me

special_situations.event: Hearing or seeing bad news about market declines (such as last week's market drop)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as the market has a pullback, it will eventually develop into a full crash and I will go bankrupt again
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Panic divestment, excessive caution to the point of decision paralysis
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is over; I am going to lose everything again this time

special_situations.event: Economic downturn or negative macro news
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any negative sign means I will repeat the same mistakes and sooner or later lose all my money
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sells early, avoids any risky investment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: no matter what, sooner or later I will lose everything

special_situations.event: When small setbacks or fluctuations occur in business or investments
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a small setback occurs, it means the whole thing is doomed to fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-harshness and reduced decision-making, procrastination, or making extreme adjustments
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is heading toward failure again

special_situations.event: Facing the need to make new investment/financial decisions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: as long as I make one wrong decision, I will lose everything; either completely safe or totally failed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not deciding or being extremely conservative/withdrawing quickly for 'absolute safety'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will likely get it wrong and lose everything

core_conflict.wish: longing for financial security and controllability, longing to never experience failure again
core_conflict.fear: Fears going bankrupt again and losing everything, fears wrong decisions ruining life
defense_goal: Avoids risk by maintaining high vigilance and control
keeping distance from risk (withdrawing investments, freezing decisions) to reduce anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: a vulnerable self, prone to failure, not confident in decisions
object_relations.object_representation: a threat-filled and unpredictable external environment/market

manifestations: though having a few family and friends to confide in, unwilling to speak about financial anxiety, tending to bear it alone
When the market fluctuates, falls into self-rumination, finding it hard to get comfort from relationships

contact_model.definition: the individual restrains the urge to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, turning to do it to oneself instead -- i.e. the individual turns libidinal energy originally directed outward toward oneself
manifestations: not communicating financial anxiety with family and friends, choosing to digest it alone
Under high-pressure situations, turns help-seeking and communication into self-restraint and tension

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact
manifestations: repeatedly emphasizing 'one wrong decision means losing everything', being overly cautious or even paralyzed when discussing investments
In sessions, rational narration overrides emotional experience; tone is cautious

positive_force: After bankruptcy, still able to rebuild finances; the objective situation is better than before
Proactively seeks external professional opinions (consulting a financial advisor); has help-seeking awareness
Has some social support network (a few family and friends to talk with)
negative_force: negative cognitive processing like catastrophizing, predicting the future, overgeneralization
decision paralysis or panicked divestment driven by anxiety, affecting business performance
Highly sensitive to negative market information, overly attentive to risk signals
avoiding discussing financial anxiety with family and friends, reducing reality testing and emotional support
Sleep impaired and persistent tension lowering cognitive and decision-making ability

target_behavior.behavior: intense anxiety during financial and market volatility with panicked decisions or decision paralysis
antecedent: economic downturns or adverse macro signals
Small setbacks or short-term fluctuations in business/investments
Facing new investment or financial decisions
target_behavior.core_reason: threat memories formed by past bankruptcy experiences and cognitive biases like catastrophizing, predicting the future, overgeneralization
target_behavior.function: escaping uncertainty and potential loss, gaining short-term safety and control
target_behavior.consequence: sleep and Decreased quality of life; impaired business performance;Interpersonal tension, overall well-being lowered
